scopeNotes: Scroll ABBA isolates the disposal patch on frozen core 4c1ee4d014; its identical autocomplete snapshot is fully prepared before input.
A separate merged verification uses final core and autocomplete, including the concurrent blank-line viewport-preservation commit.
Other fleet packages and the configured local SOFiSTiK server are linked working trees; packageRevisions records their publication-time revisions.

validation.lint: Autocomplete package and changed core/benchmark files passed ESLint.

method.cold: Fresh renderer per condition, before/after/after/before, immediate activation or 500 ms idle, 3 openings, real popup, 120 warm edits at 60 Hz per opening.
method.scroll: Before/after/after/before separately without and with SOFiSTiK LSP. 60 Enter commands at 60 Hz followed immediately by 180 wheel events at 60 Hz, then 6 seconds observation. Outline closed. No profiler or forced GC.
method.retired: Same LSP scenario with one independently parsed full-size raw WASM tree explicitly placed in the disposal queue after typing. Controlled resource-retirement stress, not a claim of ordinary per-keystroke cost.
method.syntax: Cold JS cases compare full syntax hashes. Large-file scroll cases verify settled revision, exact source, root extent and error state; they avoid whole-tree string serialization to keep its temporary allocation pressure out of subsequent cases.
